citations.quote: Good block traders must carefully set the prices at which they facilitate trades with their clients to ensure that they will be able to trade out of their positions at a profit.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Upstairs block dealers and brokers supply depth to large uninformed traders by screening counterparties for information and honesty, since exposing a block invites front-running and adverse selection.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Block Traders and Upstairs Markets: Supplying Depth to Large Orders
